params.description: A `Tensor`. The tensor from which to gather values.
constraints: The tensor from which to gather values.

indices.description: A `Tensor`. Must be one of the following types: `int32`, `int64`. Index tensor.
constraints: Index tensor. Must be one of the following types: int32, int64.
indices must be one of int32, int64

batch_dims.description: An integer or a scalar 'Tensor'. The number of batch dimensions.

bad_indices_policy.description: A string. If `""` or `"DEFAULT"`, the default behavior is used (error on CPU and ignore on GPU). If `"IGNORE"`, the bad indices are ignored and 0 is stored in the corresponding output value. If `"ERROR"`, an error is raised. Accelerators generally don't support `"ERROR"`.
constraints: A string. If "" or "DEFAULT", the default behavior is used (error on CPU and ignore on GPU). If "IGNORE", the bad indices are ignored and 0 is stored in the corresponding output value. If "ERROR", an error is raised. Accelerators generally don't support "ERROR".
bad_indices_policy must be one of IGNORE, ERROR, CPU, GPU

output.description: A `Tensor`. Has the same type as `params`.

constraints: x and y must have broadcast-compatible shapes (implicit, rule 13)
